verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an MCP plugin that lets your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for Model Context Protocol clients. This puts an OAuth flow directly in front of an MCP server, and the homepage advertises 'MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation'. The JWT plugin adds a JWKS endpoint for token verification. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped tokens and which MCP/OAuth spec details are implemented (e.g. dynamic client registration, protected resource metadata), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP OAuth flow.
